scoutPriorityAction: Post a Be Kind to Animals Week reel today featuring a Williamsburg walk and a local rescue shoutout, tagging a Brooklyn shelter to seed referral reach.

content.instagram_post_copy:
It's Be Kind to Animals Week, and we're spending it the way we spend every week — walking dogs through Williamsburg and making sure they get home happy.

Today's walks are on the cloudier, windier side, so we're keeping to inland routes — McCarren, Bedford corridors — better for shorter coats and smaller dogs than the waterfront gusts right now.

If you adopted your dog from a Brooklyn rescue, we'd love to hear about it. This week we're thinking about the shelters and organizations doing the quiet, unglamorous work of getting dogs into good homes. Shoutout to @badassbrooklynanimalsrescue — if you're looking to adopt or support, they're worth knowing.

Since 2011, same neighborhood, same commitment. DM us if you're looking for a walker who actually knows your block.

#WilliamsburgDogs #BeKindToAnimalsWeek #BrooklynDogs
